title: software-factory implement output
description: What the implement stage returns: its report as markdown, and whether it finished.

report.description: The implementation report, as markdown. Its first line is one sentence summarising the outcome.

blocked.description: True if the stage did not complete the work: blocked, or the revised plan turned out unimplementable.

blocked_reason.description: Why, when blocked is true. Empty string when blocked is false.
